status: Local validated changes; no commit, push or release.
default_transport: Pingora remains the default. Cached fixed plans and metric handles belong to the experimental Hyper transport.
source_hash_scope: Changed Rust modules and the expanded existing integration verifier, captured before the release build and checked unchanged after all validation. Not a full clean-checkout provenance record.

patch.scope: Delta against this turn's captured dirty worktree, not against clean HEAD.

probe_initial_failure.method: All emitted MetricVec::with_label_values monomorphs traced by ELF-symbol uprobes. One persistent connection, 10 warm and 500 GET requests, each validating status and the complete 1 KiB body. A separate one-request W3C control forces the general request path and verifies probes record nonzero lookups. Background calls included; counts exclude inlined lookups and are not throughput evidence.

import http.client
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / 'scripts'))
from benchmark_compare import start, stop
from integration import request, wait_for

base = Path('/var/tmp/rgnix-forward-20261001')
profile = json.loads(Path('/var/tmp/rgnix-worker-20261001/profile-local/result.json').read_text())
matrix = json.loads(Path('/var/tmp/rgnix-worker-20261001/product-1k.json').read_text())
fixture = Path('/var/tmp/rgnix-worker-20261001/profile-local/fixture')
previous = next(r for r in profile['records'] if r['engine'] == 'hyper')
ports = matrix['ports']
result = {'method': 'All emitted MetricVec::with_label_values monomorphs traced by ELF-symbol uprobes. One persistent connection, 10 warm and 500 GET requests, each validating status and the complete 1 KiB body. A separate one-request W3C control forces the general request path and verifies probes record nonzero lookups. Background calls included; counts exclude inlined lookups and are not throughput evidence.', 'records': []}

for name, binary in [('before', Path('/var/tmp/rgnix-dispatch-20261001/rgnix-idle-probe')), ('metrics', base/'rgnix-metrics')]:
    work = base / ('lookups-fixed-' + name)
    work.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    demangled = subprocess.check_output(['nm', '-nC', str(binary)], text=True)
    addresses = {line.split()[0] for line in demangled.splitlines() if 'MetricVec<T>::with_label_values' in line}
    symbols = [line.split()[2] for line in subprocess.check_output(['nm', '-n', str(binary)], text=True).splitlines() if len(line.split()) >= 3 and line.split()[0] in addresses]
    assert symbols, 'no emitted lookup functions'
    text = next(line.split() for line in subprocess.check_output(['objdump', '-h', str(binary)], text=True).splitlines() if len(line.split()) >= 7 and line.split()[1] == '.text')
    text_address, text_offset = int(text[3], 16), int(text[5], 16)
    offsets = [int(address, 16) - text_address + text_offset for address in sorted(addresses)]
    group = f'rgnix_lookup_{os.getpid()}'
    events, origin, server, recorder = [], None, None, None
    item = {'phase': name, 'binary': str(binary), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'symbols': symbols, 'file_offsets': offsets, 'windows': []}
    try:
        for index, offset in enumerate(offsets):
            event = f'{group}:lookup_{index}'
            subprocess.run(['perf', 'probe', '-x', str(binary), '-a', f'{event}={offset:#x}'], check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
            events.append(event)
        origin = start(['taskset','-c',matrix['settings']['origin_cpus'],profile['binaries']['origin']['path'],'-p',str(fixture/'origin'),'-c',str(fixture/'origin/nginx.conf'),'-g','daemon off;'], work/'origin.log')
        wait_for(lambda: request(ports['primary'], '/proxy-1k')[0], 200)
        command = [str(binary) if value == profile['binaries']['hyper']['path'] else value for value in previous['server_command']]
        item['server_command'] = command
        server = start(command, work/'server.log')
        wait_for(lambda: request(ports['http'], '/proxy-1k')[0], 200)
        client = http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1', ports['http'], timeout=10)
        def send(control=False):
            headers = {'Host': 'localhost'}
            if control:
                headers['traceparent'] = '00-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef-0123456789abcdef-01'
            client.request('GET', '/proxy-1k', headers=headers)
            response = client.getresponse()
            assert response.status == 200 and response.read() == b'x'*1024
        for _ in range(10):
            send()
        for window, count in [('plain', 500), ('control', 1)]:
            data = work / (window+'.data')
            recorder = subprocess.Popen(['perf','record','-e',','.join(events),'-p',str(server.pid),'-o',str(data)], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
            time.sleep(.3)
            assert recorder.poll() is None
            for _ in range(count):
                send(window == 'control')
            time.sleep(.3)
            recorder.send_signal(signal.SIGINT)
            _, diagnostic = recorder.communicate(timeout=15)
            assert recorder.returncode in [0, -signal.SIGINT], diagnostic
            recorder = None
            decoded = subprocess.check_output(['perf','script','-i',str(data),'-F','comm,pid,tid,time,event'], text=True, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
            counts = collections.Counter(re.findall(group+r':(lookup_\d+)', decoded))
            item['windows'].append({'name': window, 'requests': count, 'calls': sum(counts.values()), 'calls_by_event': dict(counts), 'instrument_output': diagnostic})
        assert item['windows'][1]['calls'] > 0, 'control did not trigger the installed probes'
        client.close()
        print(name, [(w['name'], w['calls']) for w in item['windows']], flush=True)
    finally:
        if recorder and recorder.poll() is None:
            recorder.send_signal(signal.SIGINT)
            recorder.communicate(timeout=15)
        stop(server)
        stop(origin)
        for event in reversed(events):
            subprocess.run(['perf','probe','-d',event], check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        result['records'].append(item)
        (base/'metric-lookups.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2)+'\n')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Count libc copies and clocks for warmed HTTP/1 requests on Linux AArch64."""
import argparse
import bisect
import collections
import ctypes
import hashlib
import http.client
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import signal
import subprocess
import time

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/Users/livesite/Documents/ChatGPT/rgnix/scripts")
from benchmark_compare import start, stop
from integration import request, wait_for


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--profile", type=Path, required=True, help="profile_http.py result with retained fixture paths")
    parser.add_argument("--matrix", type=Path, required=True, help="benchmark JSON used by profile_http.py")
    parser.add_argument("--work-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--engines", nargs="+", default=["hyper", "prototype", "pingora"])
    parser.add_argument("--binary", type=Path, help="replace the product binary for a candidate run")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if os.uname().machine != "aarch64":
        parser.error("probe return-address registers currently require Linux AArch64")
    profile = json.loads(args.profile.read_text())
    matrix = json.loads(args.matrix.read_text())
    selected = {r["engine"]: r for r in profile["records"] if r["engine"] in args.engines}
    if set(selected) != set(args.engines) or "nginx" in selected:
        parser.error("engines must identify non-forking Rust processes in the profile")
    work = args.work_dir.resolve()
    work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    fixture = args.profile.resolve().parent / "fixture"
    ports = matrix["ports"]
    libc = str(args.binary.resolve())
    group = f"rgnix_http_{os.getpid()}"
    events = []
    origin = server = recorder = None
    result = {"method": "Prefixed jemalloc allocation/reallocation entry uprobes for Rust GlobalAlloc. One connection, 10 warm and 500 status/body-validated requests. Background allocations included; internal jemalloc callers excluded to avoid nested API double counting. calloc assumes the verified Rust wrapper calloc(1,size). Requested bytes are cumulative, not live memory; not throughput evidence.", "records": []}
    try:
        for kind in ["malloc", "mallocx", "calloc", "realloc", "rallocx"]:
            register = "x0" if kind in ["malloc", "mallocx"] else "x1"
            location = f"_rjem_{kind} bytes=%{register}:u64 caller=%x30:x64"
            subprocess.run(["perf", "probe", "-x", libc, "-a", f"{group}:{kind}={location}"], check=True)
            events.append(f"{group}:{kind}")
        origin = start(["taskset", "-c", matrix["settings"]["origin_cpus"], profile["binaries"]["origin"]["path"], "-p", str(fixture / "origin"), "-c", str(fixture / "origin/nginx.conf"), "-g", "daemon off;"], work / "origin.log")
        wait_for(lambda: request(ports["primary"], "/proxy-1k")[0], 200)
        for engine, previous in selected.items():
            binary = profile["binaries"][engine]["path"]
            command = previous["server_command"][:]
            if args.binary and engine in ["hyper", "pingora"]:
                replacement = str(args.binary.resolve())
                command = [replacement if value == binary else value for value in command]
                binary = replacement
            server = start(command, work / f"{engine}.log")
            wait_for(lambda: request(ports["http"], "/proxy-1k")[0], 200)
            connection = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", ports["http"], timeout=15)
            def send():
                connection.request("GET", "/proxy-1k", headers={"Host": "localhost"})
                response = connection.getresponse()
                assert response.status == 200 and response.read() == b"x" * 1024
            for _ in range(10):
                send()
            maps = Path(f"/proc/{server.pid}/maps").read_text()
            offset = min(int(line.split("-")[0], 16) - int(line.split()[2], 16)
                         for line in maps.splitlines() if line.endswith(binary))
            data = work / f"{engine}.data"
            recorder = subprocess.Popen(["perf", "record", "-e", ",".join(events), "-p", str(server.pid), "-o", str(data)], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
            time.sleep(0.2)
            if recorder.poll() is not None:
                raise RuntimeError(recorder.communicate()[1])
            for _ in range(500):
                send()
            recorder.send_signal(signal.SIGINT)
            _, diagnostic = recorder.communicate(timeout=15)
            assert recorder.returncode in [0, -signal.SIGINT], diagnostic
            recorder = None
            connection.close()
            stop(server); server = None
            symbols = []
            for line in subprocess.check_output(["nm", "-nC", binary], text=True).splitlines():
                match = re.match(r"^([0-9a-f]+) [tTwW] (.+)$", line)
                if match:
                    symbols.append((int(match[1], 16), match[2]))
            addresses = [address for address, _ in symbols]
            counts, sizes, copies, clocks = (collections.Counter() for _ in range(4))
            decode = subprocess.run(["perf", "script", "-i", str(data), "-F", "comm,pid,tid,time,event,trace"], text=True, capture_output=True, check=True)
            if "lost" in decode.stderr.lower():
                raise RuntimeError(decode.stderr)
            decoded = decode.stdout
            for line in decoded.splitlines():
                event = re.search(group + r":(\w+):", line)
                if not event:
                    continue
                kind = event[1]
                values = dict(re.findall(r"(bytes|caller)=(0x[0-9a-f]+|[0-9]+)", line))
                address = int(values["caller"], 0) - offset
                position = bisect.bisect_right(addresses, address) - 1
                symbol = symbols[position][1] if position >= 0 and 0 <= address - symbols[position][0] < 1_000_000 else "outside-main-binary"
                if symbol.startswith(("_rjem_", "je_")):
                    continue
                counts[kind] += 1
                if kind == "clock":
                    clocks[symbol] += 1
                else:
                    size = int(values["bytes"], 0)
                    sizes[size] += 1
                    copies[symbol] += size
            result["records"].append({"engine": engine, "binary": binary, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(binary).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "requests": 500, "events": dict(counts), "requested_bytes": sum(size * count for size, count in sizes.items()), "sizes": dict(sizes), "requested_bytes_by_caller": dict(copies.most_common()), "perf_script_diagnostics": decode.stderr, "record_output": diagnostic, "server_command": command})
            print(engine, dict(counts), "requested bytes/request", sum(size * count for size, count in sizes.items()) / 500, flush=True)
    finally:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Count libc copies and clocks for warmed HTTP/1 requests on Linux AArch64."""
import argparse
import bisect
import collections
import ctypes
import hashlib
import http.client
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import signal
import subprocess
import time

from benchmark_compare import start, stop
from integration import request, wait_for


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--profile", type=Path, required=True, help="profile_http.py result with retained fixture paths")
    parser.add_argument("--matrix", type=Path, required=True, help="benchmark JSON used by profile_http.py")
    parser.add_argument("--work-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--engines", nargs="+", default=["hyper", "prototype", "pingora"])
    parser.add_argument("--binary", type=Path, help="replace the product binary for a candidate run")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if os.uname().machine != "aarch64":
        parser.error("probe return-address registers currently require Linux AArch64")
    profile = json.loads(args.profile.read_text())
    matrix = json.loads(args.matrix.read_text())
    selected = {r["engine"]: r for r in profile["records"] if r["engine"] in args.engines}
    if set(selected) != set(args.engines) or "nginx" in selected:
        parser.error("engines must identify non-forking Rust processes in the profile")
    work = args.work_dir.resolve()
    work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    fixture = args.profile.resolve().parent / "fixture"
    ports = matrix["ports"]
    libc = "/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6"
    library = ctypes.CDLL(libc)
    base = min(int(line.split("-")[0], 16) - int(line.split()[2], 16)
               for line in Path("/proc/self/maps").read_text().splitlines() if line.endswith("/libc.so.6"))
    group = f"rgnix_http_{os.getpid()}"
    events = []
    origin = server = recorder = None
    result = {"method": "Resolved libc memcpy/memmove and clock_gettime uprobes. One connection, 10 warm and 500 measured requests. Counts include background operations and exclude inlined copies; not throughput or latency. AArch64 return addresses are mapped to ELF symbols.", "records": []}
    try:
        for kind in ["memcpy", "memmove", "clock"]:
            if kind == "clock":
                location = "clock_gettime caller=%x30:x64"
            else:
                offset = ctypes.cast(getattr(library, kind), ctypes.c_void_p).value - base
                location = f"{offset:#x} bytes=%x2:u64 caller=%x30:x64"
            subprocess.run(["perf", "probe", "-x", libc, "-a", f"{group}:{kind}={location}"], check=True)
            events.append(f"{group}:{kind}")
        origin = start(["taskset", "-c", matrix["settings"]["origin_cpus"], profile["binaries"]["origin"]["path"], "-p", str(fixture / "origin"), "-c", str(fixture / "origin/nginx.conf"), "-g", "daemon off;"], work / "origin.log")
        wait_for(lambda: request(ports["primary"], "/proxy-1k")[0], 200)
        for engine, previous in selected.items():
            binary = profile["binaries"][engine]["path"]
            command = previous["server_command"][:]
            if args.binary and engine in ["hyper", "pingora"]:
                replacement = str(args.binary.resolve())
                command = [replacement if value == binary else value for value in command]
                binary = replacement
            server = start(command, work / f"{engine}.log")
            wait_for(lambda: request(ports["http"], "/proxy-1k")[0], 200)
            connection = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", ports["http"], timeout=15)
            def send():
                connection.request("GET", "/proxy-1k", headers={"Host": "localhost"})
                response = connection.getresponse()
                assert response.status == 200 and response.read() == b"x" * 1024
            for _ in range(10):
                send()
            maps = Path(f"/proc/{server.pid}/maps").read_text()
            offset = min(int(line.split("-")[0], 16) - int(line.split()[2], 16)
                         for line in maps.splitlines() if line.endswith(binary))
            data = work / f"{engine}.data"
            recorder = subprocess.Popen(["perf", "record", "-e", ",".join(events), "-p", str(server.pid), "-o", str(data)], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
            time.sleep(0.2)
            if recorder.poll() is not None:
                raise RuntimeError(recorder.communicate()[1])
            for _ in range(500):
                send()
            recorder.send_signal(signal.SIGINT)
            _, diagnostic = recorder.communicate(timeout=15)
            assert recorder.returncode in [0, -signal.SIGINT], diagnostic
            recorder = None
            connection.close()
            stop(server); server = None
            symbols = []
            for line in subprocess.check_output(["nm", "-nC", binary], text=True).splitlines():
                match = re.match(r"^([0-9a-f]+) [tTwW] (.+)$", line)
                if match:
                    symbols.append((int(match[1], 16), match[2]))
            addresses = [address for address, _ in symbols]
            counts, sizes, copies, clocks = (collections.Counter() for _ in range(4))
            decoded = subprocess.check_output(["perf", "script", "-i", str(data), "-F", "comm,pid,tid,time,event,trace"], text=True, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
            for line in decoded.splitlines():
                event = re.search(group + r":(\w+):", line)
                if not event:
                    continue
                kind = event[1]
                counts[kind] += 1
                values = dict(re.findall(r"(bytes|caller)=(0x[0-9a-f]+|[0-9]+)", line))
                address = int(values["caller"], 0) - offset
                position = bisect.bisect_right(addresses, address) - 1
                symbol = symbols[position][1] if position >= 0 and 0 <= address - symbols[position][0] < 1_000_000 else "outside-main-binary"
                if kind == "clock":
                    clocks[symbol] += 1
                else:
                    size = int(values["bytes"], 0)
                    sizes[size] += 1
                    copies[symbol] += size
            result["records"].append({"engine": engine, "binary": binary, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(binary).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "requests": 500, "events": dict(counts), "copy_bytes": sum(size * count for size, count in sizes.items()), "sizes": dict(sizes), "copy_bytes_by_caller": dict(copies.most_common()), "clock_calls_by_caller": dict(clocks.most_common()), "record_output": diagnostic, "server_command": command})
            print(engine, dict(counts), "copy bytes/request", sum(size * count for size, count in sizes.items()) / 500, flush=True)
    finally:
        if recorder and recorder.poll() is None:
            recorder.send_signal(signal.SIGINT)
            recorder.communicate(timeout=15)
        stop(server); stop(origin)
        for event in reversed(events):
            subprocess.run(["perf", "probe", "-d", event], check=True)
        (work / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
